blueprint.title: Neighbors Helping Neighbors
blueprint.setting: A modern apartment building in Beijing, one rainy afternoon.
blueprint.problem: Xiao Hong needs to move a heavy box to her new apartment but cannot do it alone.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Xiao Hong tries to lift the box but it is too heavy.

beats.where: The hallway of the apartment building
beats.what: Xiao Hong is trying to move a large box by herself.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Li Ming sees Xiao Hong struggling and stops to observe.
beats.because: Li Ming hears Xiao Hong sighing heavily while trying to lift the box.

beats.what: Li Ming asks Xiao Hong what is wrong.
beats.because: He wants to understand why she is having trouble.

beats.what: Xiao Hong explains that the box is heavy and she needs assistance.
beats.because: Li Ming asked what was wrong.

beats.what: Li Ming agrees to help, mentioning that they are good neighbors.
beats.because: He hears her request for help.

beats.what: They put the box down safely inside.
beats.because: They walked up the stairs together carrying the box.
beats.arrivedHow: They walked up one flight of stairs.

blueprint.resolution: The box is safely inside Xiao Hong's apartment, and the two neighbors feel happy to have helped each other.

targetPlan.why: Xiao Hong must express her lack of ability to do the task alone.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.refersTo: The physical act of lifting and moving the box.
targetPlan.intent: To admit that she cannot do it by herself.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 这个箱子太重了，我需要帮助。

targetPlan.why: She is making a specific request for physical aid.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.refersTo: The assistance Li Ming can provide.
targetPlan.intent: To ask Li Ming to lift the other end of the box.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 你能帮助我吗？

targetPlan.why: Li Ming wants to justify why he is helping her freely.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The social bond between them as neighbors.
targetPlan.intent: To explain that neighbors should help each other because of their connection.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我们是邻居，我们的关系很好。

targetPlan.why: Narrative description of the characters to reinforce gender nouns.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To identify one of the helpers.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 这个女人把箱子放在地上。

targetPlan.why: Narrative description to contrast with the previous mention.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To identify the other helper.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 那个男人笑了。

failures.message: beat 1 anchor "重": HSK 4, above the story level
beat 4 anchor "男/女人": not standard vocabulary
需要 usage sketch "这个箱子太重了，我需要帮助。": above-level vocabulary: 重

blueprint.title: The Neighbor's Dilemma
blueprint.setting: An afternoon in a residential apartment building hallway and the stairwell.
blueprint.problem: 李明 needs to carry heavy groceries up six flights of stairs to his apartment, but he is too weak to do it alone.
blueprint.incitingEvent: 李明 struggles to open the building door and enters, clearly burdened.

beats.what: 李明 enters carrying too many bags. He looks tired.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: 小红 sees 李明 struggling. She greets him and notices his difficulty.
beats.because: Because 李明 is visible and struggling, 小红, who lives there, observes him.

beats.what: 小红 asks if he needs help. 李明 admits he needs assistance because the bags are heavy.
beats.because: Because 小红 saw his struggle, she offers; because he is tired, he admits the need for aid.

beats.what: They start climbing. 李明 looks at a stranger helping on the stairs, noting that men usually do this work, but it doesn't matter.
beats.because: Because they agreed to go together, they are now moving to the destination (the apartment). He reflects on social roles during the exertion.

beats.what: They arrive. 李明 admits he can't carry the last bag. He suggests he must rest, and if he rests, the bags won't get up.
beats.because: Because they have been climbing for several minutes, exhaustion sets in, creating a final obstacle to the resolution.

beats.what: 小红 refuses to stop. She explains they are good neighbors (relationship), so she will finish carrying them. Problem resolved.
beats.because: Because 李明 expressed inability to continue, 小红 resolves the conflict by invoking their social bond.

blueprint.resolution: 小红 carries the remaining bags into 李明's apartment. The physical burden is gone, and the social bond is strengthened.

targetPlan.why: To establish 小红's identity in third person or via narrative description, distinguishing gender roles implicitly or explicitly as she approaches.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator
targetPlan.intent: To identify the character approaching 李明.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 那个女人是小红。

targetPlan.why: To articulate the gap between current ability and the task required.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: His situation with the heavy bags
targetPlan.intent: To admit inability to do it alone.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我太累了，我需要人帮我。

targetPlan.why: To propose a solution to the stated need.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.refersTo: The action of carrying the bags
targetPlan.intent: To offer support.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我可以帮你拿这些袋子吗？

targetPlan.why: To create a contrast during the physical activity, perhaps comparing general expectations (men do heavy lifting) with the current reality.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To make small talk or explain why he feels embarrassed asking a woman.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 通常男人搬重东西，但你力气真大。

targetPlan.why: To set up a conditional constraint based on his physical limits.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.intent: To explain why he cannot continue alone.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 如果我休息，我就搬不上去了。

targetPlan.why: To express obligation or necessity driven by circumstance.
targetPlan.speaker: 李明
targetPlan.refersTo: The necessity of getting the bags upstairs
targetPlan.intent: To state the unavoidable requirement of the task.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我必须把这些拿到六楼。

targetPlan.why: To justify the extra effort beyond mere politeness, grounding it in social obligation.
targetPlan.speaker: 小红
targetPlan.intent: To reassure him that helping is the right thing to do between friends/neighbors.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我们关系很好，这不算什么。

blueprint.title: The Neighbor's Request
blueprint.setting: A residential apartment building, on a weekend afternoon.
blueprint.problem: 李明 wants to maintain a good relationship with his neighbor, but he does not know how to properly respond to her request for help.
blueprint.incitingEvent: Wang 'a-yi asks Li Ming to help her carry groceries from the first floor to her apartment on the third floor.

beats.what: Li Ming is at home. He hears a knock on the door.
beats.because: the story opens

beats.what: Li Ming opens the door and sees Wang 'a-yi. She is a neighbor, a woman who lives next door.
beats.because: Li Ming heard the knock, so he opens the door to see who it is.

beats.what: Wang 'a-yi explains she needs to go to the market, but she has heavy things. She asks if Li Ming can help her carry the bags.
beats.because: Wang 'a-yi is at the door having been introduced, and she has a problem (heavy bags) she needs to solve.

beats.what: They walk downstairs together. Wang 'a-yi talks about how men are often stronger than women, but she thinks Li Ming is very kind.
beats.because: Li Ming agreed to help, so they move from the apartment to the location of the bags.

beats.what: Wang 'a-yi says that if Li Ming helps her, she will give him fruit in the future. She values their relationship.
beats.because: They are in the lobby preparing to lift the bags, and Wang 'a-yi wants to express gratitude and motivate Li Ming.

beats.what: Li Ming helps her carry the bags up. He feels happy. The problem of the heavy bags is solved, and the relationship is better.
beats.because: They lifted the bags at the lobby, so they now carry them to the final destination.

blueprint.resolution: Li Ming successfully helps Wang 'a-yi, and they both feel good about their neighborly relationship.

targetPlan.why: Li Ming introduces Wang 'a-yi to himself or acknowledges her identity as a neighbor who is female.
targetPlan.speaker: Narrator or Li Ming
targetPlan.intent: To identify who is at the door.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 王阿姨是一位邻居，她是一位女人。

targetPlan.why: Wang 'a-yi explicitly asks for assistance with her physical task.
targetPlan.speaker: Wang 'a-yi
targetPlan.intent: To request Li Ming's aid.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 你能帮助我吗？

targetPlan.why: Wang 'a-yi explains the necessity of help due to the weight of the items.
targetPlan.speaker: Wang 'a-yi
targetPlan.intent: To justify her request.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 这些东西很重，我需要帮助。

targetPlan.why: Wang 'a-yi makes a general comment about gender differences in strength to compliment Li Ming.
targetPlan.speaker: Wang 'a-yi
targetPlan.intent: To explain why she asked him specifically.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 这个男人很厉害。

targetPlan.why: Wang 'a-yi adds another positive trait to her description of Li Ming.
targetPlan.speaker: Wang 'a-yi
targetPlan.intent: To elaborate on her compliment.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 他很强壮，而且他很友好。

targetPlan.why: Wang 'a-yi discusses the social connection between neighbors.
targetPlan.speaker: Wang 'a-yi
targetPlan.refersTo: The bond between Li Ming and herself
targetPlan.intent: To express the value of being good neighbors.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 我们的关系很好。

targetPlan.why: Wang 'a-yi sets a condition for her future reward.
targetPlan.speaker: Wang 'a-yi
targetPlan.intent: To make a conditional promise.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 如果你帮助我，我给你水果。

targetPlan.why: Wang 'a-yi emphasizes the obligation or importance of mutual help in their community.
targetPlan.speaker: Wang 'a-yi
targetPlan.intent: To state a moral rule or strong belief.
targetPlan.usageSketch: 邻居必须互相帮助。
